describe.description: The image shows a single four-legged equid-like mammal in strict right-facing side profile against a plain off-white background. The animal has a slender, brown-coated body with a lighter tan belly and inner legs, a long head with a white muzzle, large upright ears, a short stiff upright mane along the neck, and a thin tail with a dark tuft at the tip. All four legs are visible and end in single hooves, and the animal is standing with its head held slightly forward and ears erect.
